r42.summary: Addresses that bounce or complain are never emailed again, the faster live channel switches on, owners hear about a booking the moment it starts counting toward their revenue, and a rental covered by a credit card must be paid with that card's network.

staff: A deposit hold on a card now lasts about 30 days on Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover cards (about 7 days on other cards), so fewer holds need to be placed again during a rental
If a card cannot take the longer hold, the usual hold is placed by itself, so nobody is stopped
Sales gets a To-do for every request to book that was refused or failed, once per person, car and day; it closes by itself when the request arrives
When a booking that was left out of the owner's revenue starts counting, the owner gets the new booking email once, at that moment
admins: Requests that did not go through on All leads shows how many, the reasons, and each person with the car and dates
Connect the search console with one button and the site reads its own search figures every day: clicks, impressions and average position for the last 28 days
A page that ranks just under the first results, or is shown often and rarely clicked, is written again by itself, a few pages a day; the sitemap is submitted every day
An address whose mailbox does not exist, or that reports one of our emails as unwanted, is blocked automatically and not emailed again
A card of another network than the one that covers a rental is refused on the server before the booking is confirmed, with nothing charged
More people can send requests from one shared internet connection in an hour (30, was 5)
owners: You hear about a booking the moment it starts counting toward your revenue: the new booking email arrives once, at that moment, never twice

The owner guide now says which bookings an owner statement carries: bookings paid by the renter always, and not a booking billed to an insurer that is hidden from you or that does not block the calendar
renters: When your rental is covered by your credit card, the pay page says "Pay with the card that covers this rental" with the card's network, and stops a card of another network before it is charged
A request to book that cannot be sent now says exactly what to change, beside the field, and keeps everything you typed
An add-on that cannot be added online no longer stops your request: staff confirm it in the offer
investors: Fewer lost requests: a request to book that is refused or fails is kept, and Sales follows up with the person
Emails to addresses that bounce or complain stop automatically, which protects our sending reputation
The site reads its own search figures every day and rewrites pages that rank just under the first results

r43.summary: Staff taking calls get a Call helper, only Sales is hired by the AI interview by itself, with video answers scored out of 10 and a stricter pass, every car shows its front exterior first, and the Protection Plan switch uses the car's own price.

staff: When you close a sale with a customer, you keep their conversation on every later booking too
The AI does not answer a customer for 30 minutes after a person replied to them
Check-in and check-out are one screen instead of ten to fourteen steps, with the odometer, fuel and keys filled in for you and a tick on each part when it is done
A late return is never charged by itself: on the return screen or the booking you choose an extension, extra days, the late return fee, a custom amount or a waiver, each with a reason where needed
The caller pop-up has a Call helper with a greeting, a button for each kind of call and quick answers; it minimizes to a small bar when you click outside it
Every list of people and records can be sorted newest first, and opens newest first
Hiring and onboarding are one pipeline with the next action on each line
After each release a What's new pop-up shows what changed
admins: Only Sales applicants are hired by the AI interview by themselves; every other role that passes books an interview date
The AI interview takes video answers only, with two minutes per question, scores each answer out of 10 and is stricter; Redo the AI interview sends a new link
Approvals waiting for you are first on Staff and roles and on Today
Redo photos with Gemini remakes a car's outside photos, and every car's first photo is its front exterior
Switching a booking to the Protection Plan uses the car's plan price
Add a rental: the renter's email is optional for past rentals, insurer-billed rentals, or when marked not to email
owners: Your dashboard and car pages show each car's current kilometres and its next service, in km or by date
renters: If sending "I've returned the car" hits a server hiccup it is tried again by itself
Every car's first photo is its exterior from the front
Returning the car yourself always sends your report: if a photo or reading is missing, staff confirm the return instead of the form refusing
investors: Hiring is stricter: video-only AI interviews scored per answer, and only Sales is hired without a person
Check-in and check-out are faster and late returns are charged by a staff decision, never automatically

r44.summary: Staff make and take calls in the browser from anywhere, Sales sees which cars are free for any dates, every car's listing photos are made to one Gemini standard with the front exterior first, and owner statements count a cancellation only for what it kept.

staff: Calls are made and taken in the browser, in the staff portal, on the business number: your own phone number is never used or shown, wherever you work from

A call to the business number rings the browsers of customer service and Sales who have a staff page open, with Answer and Decline; nobody answering gives the caller a short message and a missed call with its task
During a call: Mute, a keypad and Hang up, with the call's timer
At the top of Calendar, pick the customer's dates: every car says Available or Not available with the reason and the next free date, and Offer these dates starts the offer
The calendar's colours now say on rent, confirmed, offer or hold, maintenance and block
Once hired: training first and claiming shifts online, then a hello in the team chat and your member tag "Name - Position" in each WhatsApp group
Changing the amount of a line on the Money tab now changes the booking's total and balance with it, so no balance appears that nobody owes
A failed card attempt says what became of it: settled by a payment received another way, nothing owing any more, or a button to record the payment
A Sales person who closed a sale keeps that customer's chats, calls and conversations on every later booking
The automatic AI answer waits when a person replied to that customer in the last 30 minutes, also when the reply went to their booking or account, and in the live chat
The Protection Plan can be offered on a car with no value on file, on every screen that offers it

Field staff see Missing check-in and check-out on Today: past rentals they handled or were given, each with Add the photos and readings (odometer, fuel, damage photos), including closed bookings and pickups recorded with the details later
Fleet sees every missing one on the Field jobs page and gives each to a field staff member
owners: Rental history on Cars > Bookings lists every rental on your cars: booking number, car and plate, pickup and return, days, status and your earnings from your approved statements
Choose one car or all, oldest or newest first; the totals at the top count every rental in the list
Renter details, payments and deposits are never shown; a cancelled booking is listed only when a charge was kept
admins: On a phone, the portal menu opens over the page with its button kept at the top, so a long menu scrolls and still closes (Esc closes it too)
Staff who live in Canada get Canadian terms on their agreement (Canada, CAD, paid by Interac e-Transfer or direct deposit) and never read as being in the Philippines
The same phone bar on every Admin page: Admins call and answer in the browser too
The same Which cars are free view on the Admin calendar, with Offer these dates
New settings: calls in the browser, whose browser rings, how long it rings, a forward number when nobody answers (empty by default) and the message callers hear
The AI interview decides by itself again by default: only Sales passes are hired; every other role books an interview
The welcome email gives no start date, shows each step in full, and has a button to the staff portal
A person who works in Sales only reads only their own leads from their own session
Change the total on the Money tab sets a booking's total cleanly; the difference goes on the rental charge
An ended rental can get its rental agreement for the insurer's file: Make the agreements again or Sign on this device prepares it, and details not on file print blank
The replacement rental agreement shows the insurer's authorized days and daily rate, with totals that match the insurer invoice exactly
Insurer invoices carry a cheque section beside the e-Transfer details, never show the CarmaCars name, and stop saying Draft once issued
Take instant booking away is on the renter's page as well as the booking page
Data Health lists bookings whose deposit reads as charged with no deposit money recorded
Missing check-in and check-out on Field jobs lists every past rental without its photos and readings, with Give to field staff
An insurer invoice can be sent or marked sent from the booking; Send by email goes to the adjuster's email on the booking, else the insurer's billing email
renters: Calls from CarmaCars always show the business number
A deposit that was never paid no longer reads as charged on the booking
I've returned the car and photos for Report a problem send from a phone browser opened by a text message link

r45.summary: Every car's listing photos are made again by Gemini from the originals, in the CarmaCars showroom with every plate blurred, every angle present and the front exterior first. Booking requests fill themselves from the renter's profile, a changed booking can be put back to an earlier version, field shifts open by themselves, staff agreements can be redone and a townhall that did not happen counts nobody absent.

admins: Photo standard on Listings: each car's photos at the standard, angles generated, photos flagged and the last run, with Redo this car now and Redo every car (Fleet has the same card)
The whole fleet is brought to the standard by itself every 5 minutes, newest listed cars first, within about a day; a photo already at the standard is never made again unless asked
New settings: the daily Gemini limit is 2000 calls, with 50 kept for new uploads
Generated angles are marked AI generated on the listing; a real photo of that angle replaces it by itself
The plate editor blurs the plate; it no longer draws a plate
Send a new agreement redoes a staff agreement already sent or signed with the current terms; a signed one stays on file as superseded
A To do lists the staff in Canada whose agreement still carries the old terms
This townhall did not happen and Cancel this townhall on the Townhall page
The shift template is a Program setting, and shifts open only forward from the latest one already published
renters: Signed in, a booking request fills itself from your profile: your name, date of birth, licence class and how we reach you, all editable
A licence that has expired or an old address on file is flagged for you to update, and drivers you named before are one tap away
staff: Picking a renter on Send an offer or Add a rental shows their licence, home address and drivers named before, with anything out of date flagged
Restore this version puts a confirmed booking back to an earlier version's dates, car, rental charge and fees, after a preview, without touching a payment
Field shifts are published by themselves, one shift every second day from 10:00 to 17:00, and every handover or return gets a shift to claim
A townhall that did not happen counts nobody absent, and a cancelled one sends no reminders
The guides and the academy cover the new flows of Releases 44 and 45

r46.summary: An Admin can show one lead's full phone number to one salesperson and hide it again; pop-ups and the top row fit a phone; four pages are sturdier; the Canada agreements To do leaves out test accounts.

admins: Show the phone to on a lead (its page or its card) shows its full number to the lead's salesperson, or to a Sales person you choose, with an optional reason kept in the audit log
Hide it again hides it; reassigning the lead hides it by itself, so the new salesperson needs it shown again
A salesperson's ask arrives as a To do with Show the phone
The same buttons are on every Admin lead view, the expired offers on Renters > Leads included
On a phone, What's new, Report a bug and the other buttons of the top row keep their words inside the button, and every pop-up fits the screen
Admin > Field jobs no longer fails to load
The To do to send staff in Canada a new agreement lists real staff only, never a test account
staff: Sales: Ask an Admin to show the number on a lead whose number is hidden; once shown, that lead says Number shown by an Admin and has the full number with a call link and Copy
An alert tells you when an Admin shows you a number, and opens the lead
The number is shown for that lead only, and hidden again if the lead goes to another salesperson
On a phone, What's new, Report a bug and every pop-up fit the screen; long words and links wrap
Game leads no longer fails to load
renters: After the site is updated, a page left open reloads once by itself instead of showing an error
The pay page works with Chrome's translation on

r47.summary: A car's own photos stay on the site while their new versions are made, and the first outside photo always leads.

admins: Every booking shows its deposit beside the status for every role: Deposit held $500 on the card, No deposit hold yet or Deposit hold failed
The To do list is shorter: one New staff this week To do with what each hire still waits on, and one Pay details to verify
An insurer rental with no known end date asks you to extend or close it instead of starting late-return notices
A payment captured twice at the same moment is no longer reported as failed
An alert opens the right page for the person who clicks it: an Admin gets the Admin page and staff their own, the record behind it and the booking section it is about (Money, Car, Documents...)
Claude's connector reads the photo standard per car and for the fleet, with Gemini's use today

Claude's connector reads a booking's payments live from Stripe beside what the site recorded, and the Stripe account's balance, payouts and open requirements; a payment Stripe took that the site missed can be recorded, previewed first, nothing charged
A refused remake is flagged on Photo standard for Redo this car now; the photo stays on the site meanwhile
Photo standard shows each car's Generated set; a car with too few photos uses its check-in and check-out photos as references (never shown)
Showroom background plates in Program settings: upload a real showroom photo to replace the background of every outside view

r48.summary: A car can go out with the deposit still owed, signing and card names never wrongly block a renter, pay links ask only for what is owed, offers are edited in place and hold the car on time, messages go out at once, long rentals can be paid weekly, calls through the site open the caller pop-up, Rewards emails renters, every car is photographed the same way in one scene, and a payment plan's first payment confirms the booking.

admins: The Calendar works with a long fleet: filter by car status, class, owner and availability, group the cars and fold a group, and it stays fast with 100+ cars
A return is a check-out: the calendar shows the time the car actually came back, and the return check-out and the post-trip cleaning are two separate jobs
Several roles on one account? One portal: Working as at the top lists every role, with the pages of your other roles under it; sign-in opens the role you used last
Unfinished rentals is on Today and Bookings only, with what each one still needs
With a call open, More actions and Decline are no longer hidden under the call panel

At a pickup, an optional identity check: staff photograph the licence the person is holding and it is compared with the licence, selfie and card on file. A mismatch raises an urgent To do, Possible wrong person at pickup, for Fleet and Admin, marks the booking, and every check is kept for the dispute pack
The earnings calculator on List your car is conservative and seasonal, with a clear "rough estimate, not a promise"; its starting days, discount and season are in Settings > Program
An owner's Overview shows the same Forecast the owner sees; the GTA seasonal curve (a factor a month) and an average month's occupancy are in Program settings

Owner payouts follow each owner's agreed split: every rental day at the terms in force that day; correct a car's terms from its start with the reason (the owner signs again only if they get less), and approved statements not paid out are recomputed with an audit line
Shareholder cars keep 90% of everything charged on a booking (rental, every fee and amounts kept from the deposit), before tax
An owner who referred another owner gets their share of the referred owner's management fee on each statement and sees those cars
Speeding charges over 180, 220 and 300 km/h (each its own Program setting), billed from the deposit with the tracker's record
Claude's connector adds a named fee to a returned booking (smoking, cleaning, late, km, fuel, ticket, toll, damage), corrects a car's terms, and shows each car's terms
A second tap on Hold the deposit on the card on file says the hold is already being placed instead of an error
Deposits are kept 30 days after the return before release (Program setting)

A car can go out with the deposit still owed, with the reason: the booking shows Deposit pending $X for every role, the saved card is tried each morning, the renter gets the deposit link, and after 48 hours you get a To do that opens the Money tab
Program settings shows each message type that can go by text with its texts in the last 30 days; once Email ready for production is on, only urgent messages keep their texts and the rest go by email
Claude's connector records a pickup with the deposit owed (deposit_pending: true with the reason), previewed first

A card whose name still differs goes to a To do, Check the name on the card; press Accept this card with a short reason (staff who verify bookings can too). Program setting Card in the renter's name turns the rule off
A typed signature whose name differs is accepted and listed as Check a typed signature
Approve all (n) counts only what it can approve; a proof missing a page says Waiting for the renter with the page named
A pay link for a booking defaults to and is capped at what is owed; a booking paid in full gets no balance link
The guides lay out by the room they have: no more notes or steps squeezed into a thin column in the field portal or beside a menu
Editing an offer that is out keeps what you saved: after Send the update or Save without sending, the screen and a reload show the saved car, dates, price and fees

The offer screen is one form with one main button: Send the offer for a request, Send the update for an offer that is out, with Save without sending beside it; how long it is open, Email or Text, the rate card, discounts, insurer billing and the internal note are under More options
Send the offer under Next step takes you straight to that button

The fleet calendar is easier to read on a computer and a phone: full car names, the renter and booking number on each bar, clear colours by status, today marked, and the cars and dates stay in place while you scroll
Each car on the Calendar says if it is free now (Available now) or who has it and until when; white days are free
Alerts no longer land on a general page: each opens its booking (in the right section), conversation, visit, field job, shift, staff member or car

Offers and accepted unpaid bookings stop holding the car on time; the Calendar shows them as a light hatched hold until they end. The times are in Program settings (offers open 12 hours, 1 hour before pickup at the latest, 2 hours to pay)
Logs > Emails shows how long each email took from queued to sent, and the last day's average for emails, texts and phone alerts

Long-term, paid weekly on a booking: the car stays out until notice, End rental on sets the last day, and 48 hours before the return with the next week unpaid the renter gets the pay link and you a To do (Program settings sets the hours); the connector's change_booking takes rolling_weekly and rolling_end_on

Admin > Academy: every role's path gains worked examples from its guide, and every staff member (and the Admin path) the new path The renter's side, nine steps of the renter guide with the renter's screen and its page; new hires pass it before their portal opens, staff already working have 7 days, and lesson scenes can show a guide screenshot

Calls placed from the site and calls that ring the browsers open the caller pop-up within a second, for every office role it rings; the renter's Activity log shows each call with Play, the transcript and the summary, and calls of the last 60 days missing them are looked up at Twilio and Quo
Settings > Rewards lists every Rewards email with its 30-day counts, Preview and Turn off, and the birthday and holiday rewards by tier with the holidays
Edit on a booking waiting for payment that already has a payment: another car, the dates, the places, with the price and payments kept; the connector's change_booking does the same
Claude's connector lets a main driver keep a licence from outside Ontario on one booking (licence_let_go, your Let it go with the reason), previewed first
The two pages of an OPCF 27 proof have one name on every screen: the pink slip and the OPCF 27 endorsement page
On a car, Studio photos shows each made view beside the car's own photos: Make again, Take off the site, Put on the site, and the car's scene (highway, brick building and the other scenes)
Photo standard shows the fleet's progress and about how many days are left at Gemini's daily limit
Studio photos with a blurred box where a plate is or would have been are made again by themselves; the photo check now refuses a blur or box where no plate is, or one larger than the plate
The marketing set is made from the studio photos, with up to three lifestyle shots marked AI; tick the photos you want in the ZIP for a post
Gemini calls refused for where they came from are sent through the company server, and a failed call waits and tries again instead of blocking the queue
The native phone app for iPhone and Android is built and waits for the company's developer accounts; nothing changes for renters, owners or staff until the store builds are approved
staff: Calendar: filters, groups that fold, and two named jobs at the end of each trip: Check-out (with its time) and Cleaning
More than one role (Sales and Field work, or you also own a car)? Working as switches between them from any page; no more Choose a portal
Sales: Unfinished rentals on your Today and Bookings. Everyone: your own unfinished ones show at the top of Add a rental
Welcome shows the step to do now with one large button

Handover: Check it is the renter under the licence tick. Photograph the licence they are holding, compare it with the one on file, and answer Yes or No for the card's last four digits and its name. Optional, and never photograph the card
Extensions are yours by default when you sold the booking; an Admin can give one to another salesperson or to Admin, and the commission goes to whoever handled it
The Money tab shows each extension's amount, whether it was paid and how, with Charge the card on file, Record a payment and Give to
Sales can turn on Allow debit and prepaid cards for this booking
Let a car go with the deposit owed from the check-in, Record the pickup now or the field job, with the reason; you do nothing more once it is taken
Customer service and Sales get the same offer screen: change an offer that is out and press Send the update, no need to withdraw it first
The Calendar is easier to read: full car names, the renter and booking number on each bar, today marked, and the cars and dates stay in place while you scroll
Each alert opens the exact booking, conversation, visitor or job it is about
A renter paying week by week: turn on Long-term, paid weekly on the booking and record each week's payment; the return moves by itself

Your academy has worked examples from your guide and the new path The renter's side: what renters see at each step, with the renter guide at Renter guide; staff already working have 7 days, shown on the academy page
Ask the guide first: the Assistant names the guide chapter of the page you are on
A call you place from the site, or one that rings your browser, opens the caller pop-up with the Call helper; on the renter, choose Calls to play a call or read its transcript
Every staff member sees where the cars are: Car map on Find a car (read only), and Where the car is on each car and booking page, or No tracker yet
Dates and times you type on the offer screen, Change car or dates and the calendar are Toronto time, wherever your computer is
Propose a change: one more day costs exactly what a day of the booking costs (rental, fees and coverage), or type the new total; the preview shows the price a day
A renter's licence, selfie or insurance page already approved or rejected opens again with View (for one minute, and logged); after the 90-day removal it says Removed on and the date
owners: Cars > Bookings is reorganised: your cars over the next six weeks, then On a trip, Upcoming and Past, each booking with its dates, status and money, and a filter by car
Home has a Forecast: the next 12 months of each car, projected occupancy and owner revenue, from the GTA's rental season and, after 3 months, your car's own record
Each statement says whether next month is projected higher or lower, by how much, and why
Your statement pays your agreed split; an owner who referred you is paid from CarmaCars' share, never from yours
Each car's page shows Where your car is and its trips of the last 30 days, or No tracker yet; you see the location only, never the renter or the booking
renters: Checking in yourself? Confirm it is you with a photo of your licence and a selfie. It is optional and never holds up your pickup
The rental agreement has speeding charges over 180, 220 and 300 km/h (section 10.5); agreements already signed stay as they are
The privacy policy and the rental agreement say that CarmaCars staff and the car's owner can see where the car is
Your booking page says when the deposit is still owed and how to place it
Your booking's checklist says exactly which insurance page is still missing, and its button opens that upload
Example pictures of a pink slip and an OPCF 27 endorsement page, with the parts that must show circled, and how to take the photo
A pay link asks only for what you owe; one you no longer need is cancelled by itself and never charged
We email you about your Rewards points, your tier and your free day, and a reminder before points end
From Platinum up, a rental near your birthday or on a holiday weekend costs less; add your birthday on the Rewards page
On a payment plan, your booking is confirmed as soon as your first payment is in
Paying the deposit by e-Transfer, cash or debit? Your offer and pay page show that amount (twice the card deposit) before you pay
Add a tip for the team when you pay, on your booking after the trip or from the link in the Returned email: 10, 15 or 20%, or any amount
